title: Ge Hai and Ye Qingling
summary: Mu Chen and Mo Ling feed Ye Sun'er, a 14-year-old seeded formation master looking for her sister, who took the Spiritual Land trial. Ge Qing reports to his brother Ge Hai, leader of the Ge Gang, who carries a scar Mu Chen gave him in the Spiritual Land and wants revenge. Mu Chen masters the third Senluo Death Mark and coaches Sun'er through a fight with two Iron Rhinoceroses. The Ge Gang arrives; Ye Qingling, Sun'er's sister and leader of the Ye Gang, now at Spirit herself, steps in, but Mu Chen fights Ge Hai alone. Though Ge Hai is at Spirit and Mu Chen only at late Spiritual Rotation, Mu Chen wins with the Heart Formation and the Nine Heavens Thunder Spiritual Formation. To buy his freedom, Ge Hai tells him about a Divine Reishi in a valley guarded by three high-class spiritual beasts.
events: Ye Sun'er introduces herself and says she came with her sister.
Ge Hai hears Mu Chen's name; he bears Mu Chen's scar from the Spiritual Land.
Mu Chen succeeds with the third Senluo Death Mark.
Sun'er beats two Iron Rhinoceroses by staying calm and forming arrays.
Ye Qingling arrives and shields Mu Chen; she is at Spirit.
Mu Chen defeats Ge Hai with the Nine Heavens Thunder Spiritual Formation.
Ge Hai trades news of a Divine Reishi valley for his freedom.
introduced: the perpetrator (Mu Chen's Spiritual Land nickname)
cultivation: Mu Chen is still Spiritual Rotation, Late Phase. Ge Hai and Ye Qingling are at Spirit. The third Senluo Death Mark lets Mu Chen fight an early-Spirit opponent.
